scan_metadata.run_note: Partial scan. Verified candidate subset from a limited sweep (6 corridors, 24 ZIP-level queries, 2 aggregator geo-searches, direct candidate verification). All 48 grid ZIPs now have at least one executed query row. Each ZIP is a single African-label query, not the full hide-label matrix, so ZIP rows are partial. 4 units are not executed (customs, state health, SBA PPP, registry mirrors) and 3 are blocked (INBiz, ATC, Marion County health). Coverage is 60 of 65 units. Round 3 of datasets: the Marion County food-license portal (6,884 grid records, 955 grocery-licensed) and the SBA PPP FOIA (17,734 Indiana grid rows, 146 food-retail borrowers) are executed. Customs (HTTP 403 from both sites) and ISDH (ASP.NET form, no ZIP endpoint) are blocked. Registry mirrors were not run as a geography sweep. Dataset rows (INBiz, SNAP, customs, ATC, DBNS, county health) were not run as geography sweeps. Do not treat this file as a full market census. Reformatted to the analyst output contract on 2026-10-20: report_evidence added per candidate from recorded provenance; qualifying_businesses populated with full records; gold-standard gates not evaluated (gold_standard_match null). No new sweeps were run.
